title: Fetch runtime handler
responsibility: Wraps a unit runtime in the common HTTP JSON request and response protocol.

inputs.name: runtimeFetch.runtime
inputs.description: Unit runtime to invoke for accepted POST requests.

outputs.name: runtimeFetch
outputs.description: Async Request handler returning JSON with no-store headers and the status supplied by runtimeReply. Creating the handler does not start a server or close the runtime.
